title: Robert Lee Morris Soho Two-Tone Paper Clip Chain Necklace

comparisons.notes: Robert Lee Morris Soho Two-Tone Paper Clip Chain Necklace, Web ID 26945212, same description as Woot (20in + 2in extender, lobster clasp). $40.60 sale price, $28.42 with FRIEND code. No out-of-stock notice.

writeup: Woot is selling the new Robert Lee Morris Soho two-tone paper clip chain necklace for $16.99, while Macy's charges $28.42 for the same piece even after applying its FRIEND code. It has a 20-inch chain with a 2-inch extender, wire-wrapped two-tone accents and a lobster clasp. Only a handful were left when we checked.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN from the verified Woot offer listing, model 588982TWO974.
